injuries.longComment: Singleton was able to notch double-digit stops for the fourth time in the last five games and sixth time overall this year. The linebacker also notched a sack for the third time in four weeks, getting to Raiders quarterback Fernando Mendoza for a 10-yard loss in the second quarter. Singleton is now up to 118 total tackles (54 solo), including 3.0 sacks, while also registering three passes defensed over 10 contests so far during the 2026 campaign.
injuries.shortComment: Singleton recorded 11 total tackles (three solo), including 1.0 sacks, while also adding a pass defensed during Sunday's 38-24 win over the Raiders.

injuries.longComment: McMillian had himself a day in Week 11, finishing second on the team in takedowns behind linebacker Alex Singleton (11). The cornerback was also able to strip Raiders running back Mike Washington in the third quarter, but Washington jumped on the loose ball. McMillian's biggest moment of the game came in the fourth quarter though, notching a 35-yard pick-six on an outside pass from quarterback Fernando Mendoza with two minutes left in regulation. McMillian has now registered 39 total tackles (25 solo), including 3.0 sacks, while also adding two interceptions, a forced fumble and a defensive touchdown over 10 contests this season.
injuries.shortComment: McMillian recorded eight total tackles (four solo), a forced fumble and a pick-six during Sunday's 38-24 win over the Raiders.

injuries.longComment: The wide receiver did see two targets, but he wasn't able to haul them in. Franklin has just 17 targets across 10 games this year, making nine catches for 100 yards and no scores.
injuries.shortComment: Franklin did not record a catch in Sunday's 38-24 win over the Raiders.

injuries.longComment: Trautman leaked open behind Las Vegas' defense on a play-action pass from the goal line early in the second quarter, giving Denver a 10-0 lead. He still has a big role in the Broncos' offense, but he isn't running enough routes to sustain pass-catching production worth fantasy consideration in most formats.
injuries.shortComment: Trautman caught his only target for a one-yard touchdown during Sunday's 38-24 win versus the Raiders.

injuries.longComment: Mims reeled in just one pass for the second straight game, but his 36-yard snag in the second quarter was enough to notch his second highest receiving yardage total in a contest this year. The wideout played just 15 snaps on offense, which ranked fifth at his position behind Courtland Sutton (49), Pat Bryant (40), Jaylen Waddle (39) and Troy Franklin (24) for Denver in Week 11. Mims will remain an unappealing fantasy option ahead of Friday's matchup with the Steelers.
injuries.shortComment: Mims caught one of two targets for 36 yards and also added an 11-yard rush and 22 yards as a punt returner during Sunday's 38-24 win over the Raiders.

injuries.longComment: Dobbins' opportunities have been dwindling since Week 7 against Arizona, when he dropped to 14 offensive snaps after tallying 31 the week prior. That contest against the Cardinals was when rookie Jonah Coleman returned from a four-game absence, and Coleman has since forced his way into Denver's lead-RB role with blossoming production that has included five rushing TDs over his past three games. Coleman got nearly every running-back snap for Denver on Sunday, with practice-squad elevation Cody Schrader logging just two snaps and Dobbins one. Despite Payton's proclamation that Dobbins still has a "super important" role with the team, there's little reason to expect him to be a reliable fantasy asset as long as Coleman is healthy.
injuries.shortComment: Dobbins logged just one snap in Sunday's 38-24 win over the Raiders, though head coach Sean Payton said Monday that Dobbins "is going to be super important" moving forward, Will Petersen of 104.3 The Fan reports.

injuries.longComment: The veteran kicker has now gone five straight games without missing a kick, as he's 9-for-9 on field goals and 14-for-14 on extra points in that span. With the Denver offense heating up after a slow start to the campaign, Lutz has become useful in fantasy. On the season, he's 17-for-20 on FGAs and has made all 21 of his PATs.
injuries.shortComment: Lutz made his lone field-goal attempt and all five PATs in Sunday's 38-24 win over the Raiders.

injuries.longComment: Adkins was on the field for 30 of the Broncos' 73 snaps on offense, with his 41 percent share representing a season-high mark. The fourth-year tight end out of South Carolina has mainly served as a blocking specialist for Denver, having thus far been limited to a 7-47-3 receiving line on nine targets to go with a six-yard carry through 10 appearances on the season.
injuries.shortComment: Adkins recorded a three-yard reception on two targets in Sunday's 38-24 win over the Raiders.

injuries.longComment: The wideout briefly exited the game in the third quarter after he appeared to tweak his previously injured ankle, but Bryant quickly returned and was able to finish out the contest. His four targets were fourth on the team on a day Bo Nix targeted nine different players on 35 pass attempts. The Denver offense spreads the ball around to five different receivers, three tight ends and its running backs most weeks, making it difficult for any of the pass catchers to post big numbers in the box score.
injuries.shortComment: Bryant caught three passes for 32 yards on four targets in Sunday's 38-24 win over the Raiders.

injuries.longComment: Sutton thus was blanked in the box score for the first time Week 7 of the 2024 campaign, a span of 39 games (including playoffs). Considering he's surpassed 50 receiving yards just one time in 10 appearances in 2026, he doesn't hold much sway for fantasy purposes, especially in a Broncos offense that often has sputtered this season. Sutton's next chance to turn the tide arrives Friday at Pittsburgh.
injuries.shortComment: Sutton didn't corral either of his two targets during Sunday's 38-24 victory versus the Raiders.

injuries.longComment: It was easily Engram's best performance of the season, as he set season highs in targets, catches and yards against Las Vegas. Entering Sunday, Engram had produced just seven grabs for 48 yards total over his previous four games. Engram and the Broncos have a quick turnaround ahead of Friday's date with the Steelers. The tight end will be a low-floor fantasy option for that one.
injuries.shortComment: Engram caught six of eight targets for 74 yards in Sunday's 38-24 win over the Raiders.

injuries.longComment: After a hit-or-miss first six appearances of the season, Nix has settled into a four-game stretch in which his passing yards have ranged from 222 to 237 weekly, a span in which he boasts a 6:2 TD:INT and 84 rushing yards and another score. He also displayed some promise with offseason acquisition Jaylen Waddle (3-61-0 on six targets) while connecting with TE Adam Trautman for his 12th touchdown pass in 10 contests. Nix will look to keep things rolling Friday at Pittsburgh.
injuries.shortComment: Nix completed 19 of 35 passes for 225 yards, one touchdown and one interception and notched six carries for five yards during Sunday's 38-24 victory against the Raiders.

injuries.longComment: Waddle sustained a concussion in the Broncos' last game in Week 9 at Carolina, but with the benefit of a Week 10 bye, he had enough time to gain clearance from the protocol for head injuries and miss no additional time as a result. With a 24-yard connection with QB Bo Nix on Sunday, Waddle now has recorded exactly one catch of at least that distance in four straight games. Unfortunately for Waddle's fantasy managers, his 61 receiving yards marked his second most of the campaign after a 138-yard outburst in Week 2 against the Jaguars, so he remains an underwhelming asset in most formats.
injuries.shortComment: Waddle secured three of six targets for 61 yards during Sunday's 38-24 win versus the Raiders.

injuries.longComment: Since returning from an IR stint due to a sprained ankle in Week 7, Coleman has increased his touch count in four consecutive contests, taking a stranglehold on the Broncos backfield in the process. As evidence, his 25 touches easily outpaced fellow RB J.K. Dobbins' one, which went for no yards. Coleman, a rookie fourth-round pick, also cracked the 100-yard mark on the ground for the first time in his career. With RJ Harvey (ankle) on injured reserve for at least one more game, Coleman again is set to act as a workhorse in Friday's road matchup with the Steelers.
injuries.shortComment: Coleman reeled off 111 yards and three touchdowns on 24 carries and hauled in four of five targets for 18 yards during Sunday's 38-24 win against the Raiders.

injuries.longComment: Humphrey will be a healthy scratch for a second consecutive game. His next chance to play is Week 12 against the Steelers on Black Friday, although Humphrey is unlikely to see the field unless a wide receiver ahead of him on the depth chart is not available.
injuries.shortComment: Humphrey (coach's decision) is inactive for Sunday's game against Las Vegas.

injuries.longComment: Jones will miss a second consecutive game due to a hamstring injury, which limited his practice participation during Week 11 prep. JL Skinner and Taylor Rapp are the top candidates to start alongside Talanoa Hufanga at safety in the absence of Jones, whose next chance to play is Week 12 against the Steelers on Black Friday.
injuries.shortComment: Jones (hamstring) is inactive for Sunday's game against the Raiders.

injuries.longComment: As the emergency QB3, Ehlinger is prohibited from playing Sunday unless both Bo Nix and Jarrett Stidham leave the game due to injury, illness or ejection.
injuries.shortComment: Ehlinger (coach's decision) is inactive but will serve as the Broncos' emergency third quarterback against the Raiders on Sunday.

injuries.longComment: Rapp was cut from the Broncos' active roster in early November before opting to stick around as a member of the team's practice squad. His elevation gives Denver more depth in the secondary in the event that Brandon Jones (hamstring) cannot play against the Raiders on Sunday.
injuries.shortComment: The Broncos signed Rapp from the practice squad to the active roster Saturday, Zac Stevens of TheDNVR.com reports.

injuries.longComment: Hufanga logged three consecutive full practices during Week 11 prep. The strong safety did not let his persistent ankle injury inhibit him during the week, clearing him of any injury designation that may have followed him into Sunday's contest.
injuries.shortComment: Hufanga (ankle) does not have any injury designation ahead of Sunday's game against the Raiders, Aric DiLalla of the Broncos' official site reports.

injuries.longComment: The Broncos opened Lohner's 21-day practice window Wednesday. The tight end is not quite ready to make his season debut, as he is still tending to his recovery from a foot injury he sustained in the offseason. Lohner was a full participant in all three Week 11 prep sessions, meaning his odds of returning in Week 12 are quite good if he can continue to log full sessions.
injuries.shortComment: Lohner (foot) has been ruled out ahead of Sunday's game against the Raiders, Aric DiLalla of the Broncos' official site reports.

injuries.longComment: Moss was a full participant in Friday's practice. The newly extended Broncos starter has cleared the NFL's five-step concussion protocol and is all set to suit up for Sunday's contest. The team's Week 10 bye helped Moss rest and recover from the injury he sustained during the Broncos' Week 9 win over the Panthers.
injuries.shortComment: Moss (concussion) does not have any injury designation ahead of Sunday's game against the Raiders, Aric DiLalla of the Broncos' official site reports.

injuries.longComment: One week after piling up 19 tackles (nine solo) in a loss to the Bengals, Wilson's three tackles Sunday were his fewest in a game this season. His 83 percent snap share on defense was also his lowest since Week 4. Wilson will be in position to rebound against Denver on Friday. He has 91 tackles (46 solo), including 1.0 sacks, four pass breakups, including an interception, and a fumble recovery across 10 games this season.
injuries.shortComment: Wilson recorded just three tackles (one solo) and a pass breakup in Sunday's 19-16 loss to the Eagles.

injuries.longComment: It was Wilson's first game since suffering a finger injury in Week 5 that landed him on injured reserve. He ended up playing 49 of 71 offensive snaps, 39 of which came out wide with 10 in the slot. Wilson had primarily operated as the Steelers' slot receiver prior to his injury, but Germie Bernard has emerged in that role for Pittsburgh. While Michael Pittman (foot) is expected back for Friday's game against the Broncos, DK Metcalf might receive some form of team-imposed discipline after he had an on-field meltdown against the Eagles before being ejected from the game.
injuries.shortComment: Wilson caught three of six targets for 43 yards in Sunday's 19-16 loss to the Eagles.

injuries.longComment: With Michael Pittman (foot) remaining sidelined for Week 11, Bernard retained his every-down role on offense, playing 67 of 71 offensive snaps while leading the team in routes (52) and targets. It was a nice bounce-back game for the rookie after he was held without a catch on three targets against the Bengals in Week 10. Pittman is expected back for Friday's game against the Broncos, but Bernard could keep pacing the team in playing time, especially if DK Metcalf gets disciplined for his latest on-field outburst.
injuries.shortComment: Bernard caught six passes for 40 yards on 10 targets in Sunday's 19-16 loss to the Eagles.

injuries.longComment: With DK Metcalf ejected in the second half of Sunday's loss to the Eagles, Hurleman ended up playing 22 of 71 offensive snaps in his regular-season NFL debut. The undrafted rookie ended up seeing seven targets and caught six of them for 61 yards and the Steelers' lone touchdown of the contest. He also handled two kick returns and returned a trio of punts.
injuries.shortComment: Hurleman reverted to the Steelers' practice squad Monday, per the NFL's transaction log.

injuries.longComment: Metcalf was disqualified with 4:53 remaining in the third quarter Sunday after he attempted to poke Eagles defensive back Cooper DeJean in the eye. He was flagged for unsportsmanlike conduct in what was his second major transgression of the game; Metcalf previously drew an unnecessary roughness penalty in the first half, when he held his block of DeJean well after a play had finished. Though Metcalf won't miss further game action as a result of his ejection, he may have already lost the faith of his fantasy managers heading into a Week 12 matchup with the Broncos on Friday. Metcalf has hauled in just 36 of his 74 targets (48.6 percent catch rate) and has scored just two touchdowns on the season while topping 60 receiving yards in only two of his 10 appearances.
injuries.shortComment: Metcalf won't receive a suspension after he was ejected from Sunday's 19-16 loss to the Eagles, but the NFL is still reviewing discipline for the receiver that could include a fine, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

injuries.longComment: Pittman was designated for return from IR this past Wednesday, but despite being listed as a full participant in practice Thursday and Friday, the Steelers elected to not activate the WR (who had been listed as questionable) for Sunday's 19-16 loss to the Eagles. Added context regarding Pittman's status will arrive via Pittsburgh's next practice report, but barring any setbacks, it appears as though he's approaching his first game action since Week 4.
injuries.shortComment: Steelers coach Mike McCarthy said Monday that he's "very confident" Pittman (foot) will be on the field this week when the Steelers face the Broncos on Friday, Brooke Pryor of ESPN.com reports.

injuries.longComment: Highsmith recorded a pair of sacks across just six snaps before he was forced out in the first quarter of Sunday's 19-16 loss to the Eagles due to the ankle injury. Per Jeremy Fowler of ESPN.com, the Steelers' initial belief is that Highsmith's ankle injury isn't serious, but the edge rusher will nonetheless have difficulty getting clearance to play on a short week. If healthy, Nick Herbig (hip/ribs) -- who was inactive for Week 11 -- will be the most likely candidate to start in place of Highsmith on Friday.
injuries.shortComment: Steelers head coach Mike McCarthy suggested Monday that Highsmith (ankle) is likely to be sidelined for Friday's game against the Broncos, Brooke Pryor of ESPN.com reports. "It's going to be tough for him to make it this week," McCarthy said.

injuries.longComment: out
injuries.shortComment: out

injuries.longComment: This was a battle of Pennsylvania's kickers, as Boswell and Jake Elliott combined to account for 23 of the game's 35 points. Boswell was good from 25, 40 and 52 yards. The veteran kicker has been trending downward the last two seasons, and he entered play Sunday having made just 79.2 percent of his field-goal tries this season. After his perfect showing against the Eagles, Boswell has made all of his field goals in back-to-back games for the first time all season. On the year, he's 22-for-27 on FGAs and a perfect 18-for-18 on PATs.
injuries.shortComment: Boswell went 3-for-3 on field-goal attempts and made his lone PAT in Sunday's 19-16 loss to the Eagles.

injuries.longComment: The big tight end earned just a 6.8 percent target share on a day when Aaron Rodgers fired off 44 pass attempts in prolonged comeback mode. Washington has been held to 25 yards or fewer in eight of 10 games this season. He doesn't see enough volume to warrant weekly fantasy consideration as a touchdown-or-bust bet.
injuries.shortComment: Washington caught all three targets for 22 yards in Sunday's 19-16 loss to the Eagles.

injuries.longComment: Freiermuth matched his season high in catches, securing five passes in a game for the third time this year. The tight end has yet to exceed 50 receiving yards in a contest this season, and he entered Week 11 with exactly two catches in each of the team's last four games. Freiermuth has now caught 32 of 43 targets for 309 yards and five touchdowns while also adding four rushes for five yards and a score over 10 contests so far during the 2026 season.
injuries.shortComment: Freiermuth caught all five of his targets for 39 yards during Sunday's 19-16 loss to the Eagles.

injuries.longComment: Rodgers threw a 20-yard touchdown pass to Max Hurleman on Pittsburgh's final offensive play with 1:21 remaining in the fourth quarter, but that was too little too late, as the Eagles proceeded to run out the clock to drop the Steelers to 6-4. Hurleman stepped up down the stretch in his first NFL game after starting wide receiver DK Metcalf was disqualified. Rodgers had a four-game stretch in which he threw 11 touchdown passes while posting at least 235 passing yards in each outing, but he has failed to reach that yardage total in any of his last four starts while recording only four TDs during the latter stretch. Snapping out of this recent funk won't be easy for Rodgers against the stout Broncos defense Friday.
injuries.shortComment: Rodgers completed 30 of 44 passes for 227 yards and one touchdown while rushing five times for 29 yards in Sunday's 19-16 loss to the Eagles.

injuries.longComment: Dowdle finished with 34 scrimmage yards for a second consecutive game after racking up 235 scrimmage yards over his preceding four appearances. He had five more yards than Jaylen Warren on two fewer touches in Sunday's loss. Dowdle is poised to retain his spot as the 1B option alongside Warren in Friday's Week 12 home game against the Broncos.
injuries.shortComment: Dowdle rushed five times for 15 yards and caught four of five targets for 19 yards in Sunday's 19-16 loss to the Eagles.

injuries.longComment: Warren finished with 29 yards on 11 touches compared to 34 yards on nine touches for Rico Dowdle, as Pittsburgh's backfield duo was held quiet for a second consecutive game. After recording at least 73 scrimmage yards in eight consecutive games to start the season, Warren has produced just 75 yards without a touchdown over the past two games. Warren and Dowdle should continue to split backfield touches Friday against the Broncos.
injuries.shortComment: Warren rushed nine times for 28 yards and caught two of three targets for one yard in Sunday's 19-16 loss to the Eagles.

injuries.longComment: Wetjen has operated as the Steelers' top returner on both kickoffs and punts this season. However, with Roman Wilson back from injured reserve and Max Hurleman elevated from the practice squad to the active roster, Wetjen will be a healthy scratch Sunday for the first time this season. Wetjen's next opportunity to play is Friday against the Broncos, although the rookie fourth-rounder's chances of suiting up for that contest would be further diminished if Michael Pittman (foot) is activated from IR before that game.
injuries.shortComment: Wetjen (coach's decision) is inactive for Sunday's game against the Eagles.

injuries.longComment: Queen was working through a hand injury during Week 11 prep, but the veteran linebacker has been given the green light by medical staff to play Sunday. He has logged double-digit tackles in each of his last three outings and is up to 74 tackles (25 solo), including 3.5 sacks, four pass defenses (including an interception) and one forced fumble through nine regular-season games.
injuries.shortComment: Queen (hand) is active for Sunday's game against the Eagles.

injuries.longComment: Elliott did not play in Week 10 against the Bengals due to a knee injury he sustained during pregame warmups. He drew the questionable tag for Week 11 after logging full practices Thursday and Friday, and he's been cleared by medical staff to play Sunday. Elliott's return means Robert Spears-Jennings will revert to a rotational role in the secondary.
injuries.shortComment: Elliott (knee) is active for Sunday's game against the Eagles.

injuries.longComment: As has been the case all year, Howard will be the emergency QB3 behind starter Aaron Rodgers and backup Mason Rudolph. As such, Howard is not allowed to see the field Sunday unless both Rodgers and Rudolph leave the game due to injury, illness or ejection.
injuries.shortComment: Howard (coach's decision) is inactive but will serve as the Steelers' emergency quarterback against the Eagles on Sunday.

injuries.longComment: Dunker went to IR with a sprained MCL back in late September, but it now looks like he's close to being available again. The move opens a 21-day window during which Pittsburgh can officially activate him before he'd have to go back on the shelf for the remainder of the campaign.
injuries.shortComment: The Steelers designated Dunker (knee) for return to practice from injured reserve Wednesday, Teresa Varley of the team's official site reports.

injuries.longComment: McCormick dislocated his ankle during the Steelers' 38-18 loss to the Bengals on Sunday. The good news for the third-year pro is that he avoided a fracture and does not require surgery, so there's a chance he could return for the Steelers should the team qualify for the playoffs, per Ian Rapoport of NFL Network. Brock Hoffman figures to start at left guard in McCormick's stead.
injuries.shortComment: The Steelers placed McCormick (ankle) on injured reserve Wednesday, Teresa Varley of the team's official site reports.

injuries.longComment: Pittsburgh gave up 38 points, so it wasn't exactly a stellar performance by the team's defense. However, three different Steelers players logged double-digit tackles -- including Brisker, who finished with 10. That's a season-high mark for the veteran safety, who has finished with at least six stops in all but one of his nine games so far this season.
injuries.shortComment: Brisker notched 10 tackles (two solo) Sunday in a Week 10 loss to the Bengals.
